card.name: Short words inside all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Short linking or auxiliary words (BEEN, BE, OR, FROM) in all-capital warning text, and the middle of the all-caps word STERILITY. It fires when the text is in capitals, as in boxed warnings.

modes.label: Auxiliary verbs in caps
modes.description: BEEN or BE after HAVE or SHOULD in all-caps warning sentences.
modes.example: CAUTION SHOULD<< BE>> EXERCISED BECAUSE CROSS-H

modes.label: Other caps linking words
modes.description: Words like OR and FROM in all-caps consumer or label warnings.

modes.label: Inside a capitalized word
modes.description: The ER inside STERILITY in an all-caps instruction.

card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in warnings printed entirely in capital letters.
